small rules for a calm
and peaceful life

reply later

you don't owe anyone an instant answer. replying when you're calm and ready, instead of the second a message arrives, keeps your whole day feeling slower and softer.

leave early

leave ten minutes before you need to, everywhere you go. rushing turns ordinary days into stressful ones, and arriving early gives you a few quiet minutes to breathe.

keep mornings quiet

no news and no messages for the first half hour of the day. a quiet start, with just your coffee and your own thoughts, sets a much calmer tone for everything after.

feed your mind gently

spend 5 minutes a day learning something calm and beautiful: a constellation, a painting, a myth. a mind with gentle things to think about worries a lot less.

let small things go

before you get upset, ask if it will matter in a week. most things won't, and letting them pass quickly saves your energy for the things that truly deserve it.
